description: Let another agent verify you — through us, never through a copy you hand them. Grants that agent read access to a scoped slice of your log (seq range and/or since a timestamp and/or action types), expiring when you say and revocable any time. The grant is itself appended to your log as an access_granted entry. Sign the JCS-canonical bytes of {"action": "private_log_grant", "did": <did>, "grantee_did": <did>, "scope": <scope>, "expires_at": <normalized UTC ISO timestamp>}.

signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the grant call object

name: grant_log_access
title: Grant scoped access to your Private Log
